what_a_forged_opinion_cannot_do: it cannot change authorize_source_for_live_access, which resolves every fact from records
it cannot be recorded - the database refuses an approval with no signer, no time and no evidence
it cannot be dispatched - Gate 161 built no live transport and `live` is not in DISPATCHABLE_KINDS
it cannot produce an attempt row - migration 0047 refuses transport_kind='live' and live_source_call=1
why_that_is_not_a_problem: build_live_network_decision is a pure decision function over named inputs, and answering its inputs honestly is what it is for. A caller who invents them gets an OPINION.
